_comment: A healing aura whose heal-over-time outlasts the aura's own re-apply cadence, so allies keep healing briefly after leaving the ring. Unlike a plain heal aura it also pre-hots allies at full health; a tick on a full-health target does nothing but is not wasted, since the cost only charges when the heal-over-time newly starts, not on every re-apply. All values placeholder.
name: Rejuvenation
